q: I smoothed the coastlines as you asked, but the result went boxy: the Center turned into rectangular terraces (pictures B), where before it was an organic outline drawn with 1-tile stairs (pictures A). Which way should coasts go?
ctx: Only the decorative coast changes; the playable area is untouched either way. Click a picture for full size.
o: Middle ground: keep the organic outline (A) but merge 1-tile stairs into 2-3 tile steps
